rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Report, Fees, Final Distribution
rulings.Rulings: Hearing. Appearance required. Procedural Issues on Petition: (1) Notice of hearing must be given to all persons entitled. (2) While Mr. Cate asks for 100% payable to himself, Mr. Vann's declaration filed on 7/10 seeks $7,425.00 payable to him. The Court may inquire further on the allocation of compensation. (3) Anticipated costs advanced for the total amount of $424.23 being requested; however, the examiner has not received any hard copies of documents. Procedural Issues on Objection: (1) Court's authorization to distribute. It appears that a fully noticed petition, with proper notice of hearing (PrC 11604(d)), may be necessary. While Assets Recovery alleges that 11604 is applicable, the personal rep alleges 11604.5 applies here. The Court may inquire into the surrounding circumstances. (2) Objector filed "Supplement to Counter-Petition of Asset Recovery, Inc." on 6/16/26; however, there has been no "Counter-Petition of Asset Recovery" to supplement with filing fee and a new hearing date obtained. (3) The Court to determine on notice of hearing is met under 11604(d) or 11604.5(j). PARTIES APPEARING SHOULD CHECK IN FOR THE HEARING WITH THEIR FULL NAME. Counsel and parties may appear personally or remotely through Zoom or CourtCall. For a video appearance, go to zoom.us, click "join a meeting" and input meeting ID 160 225 4765 and password 514879. rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #1, Report, Fees
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 9/1/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) No proposed order has been lodged or received by the assigned examiner. [LRSF 14.7 A. and 14.59 E.] (2) The final court accounting of the conservator following the death of the conservatee shall include a court accounting for the period that ended on the date of death and a separate accounting for the period subsequent to the date of death. [Probate Code Section 2620(b).] (3) Neither the petition nor the prayer disclosed the amount of fees requested. Fee declarations were not e-filed until 6/30/26, which was not at least 15 days before this hearing. (Notice is defective if mailed before the filing of the pleading requiring notice. [LRSF 14.14 A.] "Filing" means when the pleading requiring notice appears on the Court's register of actions and becomes publicly viewable.) Please provide a proposed order and courtesy copies of the petition and all supporting papers to the assigned examiner by 8/18/26. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B. (The accounting has not yet been reviewed, as no courtesy copy was received by the assigned examiner. [LRSF 2.7 B. and 14.7 B.])

rulings.Rulings: Continued to 08/18/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) No Confidential Statement of Birth Date and Driver's License Number (Form DE-147S) has been filed (San Francisco Local Rule 14.18.E). 2) Both Edward Rehfeldt and the San Francisco public administrator have higher priority to serve that petitioner under Probate Code Section 8461. A written declination must be filed by or on behalf of an individual who has higher priority than the petitioner for issuance of letters of administration but does not desire to act (LRSF 14.24). 3) Item 6f is marked in the underlying petition, although it appears that Item 6b applies. 4) When second generation or more distant heirs are listed, the deceased ancestor(s) through whom they take (or would have taken) must be named, the relationship(s) to the decedent stated, and the date(s) of death specified (LRSF 14.18.C.3). 5) No proposed order has been received or lodged with the court (LRSF 14.7.A). Please address the above issues and delivery courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 08/04/2026 to avoid additional continuance.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF JOSEPH DELFINO HARP
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION
rulings.Rulings: Hearing. Appearance required. PARTIES APPEARING SHOULD CHECK IN FOR THE HEARING WITH THEIR FULL NAME. Counsel and parties may appear personally or remotely through Zoom or CourtCall. For a video appearance, go to zoom.us, click "join a meeting" and input meeting ID 160 225 4765 and password 514879. For an audio-only appearance through Zoom, call 1-669-254-5252 and key in meeting ID "160 225 4765#", then participant ID "0#", then password "514879#". (Toll rates may apply).) The Court prefers that counsel and parties appearing by video input their first and last name into the "Your Name" dialogue box. Counsel and parties may appear by audio-only telephone through CourtCall by calling 1-888-882-6878. Please review LRSF 14.1(C) for more information.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF DAISY BROOKS
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR PROBATE OF WILL AND FOR LETTERS TESTAMENTARY
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 8/25/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) No proposed order has been lodged or received by the assigned examiner. [LRSF 14.7 A. and 14.59 E.] (2) No proof of service or proof of publication of the notice of this hearing has been filed. (3) Notice must have attached to it the procedures for how to make a remote appearance by Zoom and CourtCall, as well as remote public access, as set out at https://sf.courts.ca.gov/divisions/probate-court. [LRSF 14.1 C.6.] (4) The Acknowledgment of Receipt of the Duties and Liabilities has not been filed. (5) The Confidential Statement of Birth Date and Driver's License Number (Judicial Council Form DE-147S) is also required, pursuant to Probate Code Section 8404(b). Form DE-147S must be filed separately and confidentially with a cover sheet. (6) If the decedent's husband survived, who are his successors-in-interest? (Who is the trustee of his trust?) (7) When second generation or more distant heirs are listed, the deceased ancestor through whom they take (or would have taken) shall be named and his or her date of death and relationship to the decedent shall be stated. [LRSF 14.18 C.] Whose children are the two niblings and when did their parents die? Please provide a proposed order and courtesy copies of the petition and all papers filed to address these issues to the assigned examiner by 8/11/26. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B.
